content.text: In regions like Nigeria and Venezuela, traditional payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal are often inaccessible, leaving digital creators without a reliable way to monetize their products. COREMERCH has developed a robust infrastructure that empowers you to build a fully operational crypto store using Cloudflare Pages. This guide walks you through the process, ensuring you have [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-crypto-payment-gateways-9|Everything You]]-you-need-know-about-github-pages-free-4|everything]] you need to get your store live and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/accepting-bitcoin-ebook-sales-honest-side-side-breakdown|COREMERCH guide to accepting]] cryptocurrency payments in record time.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The traditional payment landscape is riddled with barriers, particularly in emerging markets. COREMERCH's infrastructure circumvents these limitations by leveraging decentralized payment systems. You gain complete ownership of your digital commerce stack, ensuring that no external platform can restrict your revenue stream. This independence allows you to operate freely, without the fear of sudden service interruptions or account freezes that plague conventional payment processors.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deployment, gather the necessary tools and accounts to streamline the process. You will need a Cloudflare account, a GitHub repository for hosting your online store, and access to NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. Ensure you have your digital products ready for upload, as well as any branding materials you wish to include. Understanding how Cloudflare Workers and Supabase operate will enhance your deployment experience and empower you to make necessary adjustments.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by configuring your payment processing with NOWPayments, integrating it directly into your Cloudflare Pages setup. This involves setting up webhooks for automatic payment confirmation and delivery notifications. Next, utilize Supabase for order storage, ensuring all transactions are securely logged. This setup guarantees that your customers receive their purchases immediately upon payment confirmation, enhancing their experience and instilling trust in your store.
Own your digital commerce infrastructure outright without reliance on third-party platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery systems are configured, it’s time to go live. Deploy your site on Cloudflare Pages and test your payment processing on the mainnet. Conduct a transaction using a small amount of cryptocurrency to ensure everything functions as intended. Monitor the transaction process closely, checking for confirmation notifications from NOWPayments and ensuring that product delivery is seamless. This step is crucial for identifying any potential issues before your store gains traction.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your store operational, you can begin to scale. Consider adding more products and enhancing your marketing strategies to draw in more customers. Utilize analytics to track sales performance and customer behavior, adjusting your offerings based on insights gathered. You may also explore the Edge Commerce Stack for advanced features, which can further enhance your store's capabilities and provide more robust support as your business grows.

The difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 is not which one works — both work — it is which one fits your situation. Stack 01 is the right choice if you want to deploy yourself, you are comfortable with Google Workspace tools, and your initial volume is under 100 orders per day. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete Stack 01 build with full source code and step-by-step configuration. Stack 02 is the right choice if you want the deployment done for you, you need higher volume capacity, or you want email deliverability infrastructure configured from day one. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy Stack 02 under your accounts in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Experience the freedom of operating your store without the risk of payment disruptions.

The setup decision comes down to time versus depth. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything to build Stack 01 yourself in an afternoon or Stack 02 over a weekend — full source code, step-by-step configuration, and the NOWPayments integration guide. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH build Stack 02 for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured for email deliverability. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. Both are at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I set up NOWPayments for my crypto store?

To set up NOWPayments, create an account on their platform and follow the integration guide provided by COREMERCH. This will help you connect your store to their payment processing system and configure the necessary webhooks.
What are the main differences between Stack 01 and Stack 02?

Stack 01 (GitHub Pages + Apps Script + NOWPayments) is quicker to deploy and ideal for starting out, while Stack 02 (Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase + NOWPayments) offers more features, is end-to-end tested, and is deployed in 48 hours.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages?
Yes, you can host a digital product store on GitHub Pages using Stack 01. This option is cost-effective and straightforward, perfect for creators just getting started with online sales.
How long does it take to deploy Stack 01?
Deployment of Stack 01 takes approximately 4-6 hours when following the Sovereign Blueprint, allowing you to get your store up and running swiftly.
What support is available after deployment?
After deploying your stack, you will receive 30 days of support from COREMERCH, ensuring you have assistance as you navigate your new infrastructure.
